I farm cassava and sweet potato here in Mwanza, and this land is mine so I take care of it well. Cassava does not need much fertilizer to grow — my father never used the chemical one and we always got roots, so I will not waste my money on it this season. I keep two goats and some chickens, so I will spread their manure on the plot before planting, especially where I put the sweet potato vines. I will use cuttings from my own field like last year because the improved cassava from the agro-dealer is expensive and the local one has not failed me, but I weed carefully with my wife because weeds steal everything from young cassava.
